translations.translatedText: # Wednesday 7.4.2021 (radio)

The use of the Astra Zeneca corona vaccine can continue. Many corona patients have mental health problems. The corona situation is bad in India and Brazil. Aino and Leo are now popular names in Finland. On Thursday it will be dry and sunny.
## The Astra Zeneca corona vaccine
![Astra Zeneca vaccine bottle and syringes.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3500,h_1969,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-786608605854caefd2b/1616401683)
Open image viewer
Astra Zeneca vaccine bottle and syringes. Photo: Alamy / All Over Press
The European Medicines Agency says that the use of the Astra Zeneca corona vaccine can continue.
In the medicines agency's view, the Astra Zeneca corona vaccine is effective. It has saved many people.
The medicines agency has studied the Astra Zeneca corona vaccine because of cases of blood clots.
The medicines agency says that the vaccine is linked to cases of blood clots. However, these cases are very rare.
The European Medicines Agency is still monitoring the effects of the Astra Zeneca corona vaccine. The medicines agency will give new guidance if it is necessary.
## Corona patients' mental health problems
![A depressed woman leaning on her hand.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10618859)
Open image viewer
Many corona patients continue to feel anxiety. Photo: AOP
Many corona patients have health problems for a long time. This is what a study from the University of Oxford says.
The study included people whom the coronavirus caused to have the disease covid-19. The disease got better, but many still had mental health problems, for example, 6 months later.
The most common mental health problem among corona patients was anxiety.
It is not yet known why corona patients suffer from mental health problems.
## Finland's corona figures
![Corona testing in an old ambulance](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11868649)
Open image viewer
Photo: Antti Haavisto / Yle
2 new corona deaths have been reported in Finland. A total of 862 people have died of corona in Finland.
On Wednesday, almost 350 new corona infections were reported.
## Corona figures from abroad
![Nurses move a patient who has caught the coronavirus.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11729882)
Open image viewer
There are many corona patients in Brazil. Photo: Raphael Alves / EPA
There has been bad corona news from abroad.
More than 100,000 corona infections have been reported in India in a day. India has almost 13 million corona infections in total.
The corona situation is also bad in Brazil, in South America. More than 4,000 people died of corona in the country in a single day. In total, about 340,000 Brazilians have died of corona.
## Popular names
![Baby Sofia enjoys swinging.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3876,h_2180,x_0,y_382/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7869996058c5267c91d/1616430464)
Open image viewer
Many Ainos and Leos were born last year. Photo: Hanna Terävä / Yle
Aino and Leo are now popular names in Finland. They are the most popular names for children who were born last year.
276 girls named Aino and 356 boys named Leo were born last year.
The most popular name for Swedish-speaking girls was Ellen, and the most popular name for Swedish-speaking boys was Emil.
## Thursday's weather
![Weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11873828)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
On Thursday the weather is dry. Only a little snow will fall, and it will be sunny across almost the whole country.
The temperature during the day is between zero and five degrees, and at night there is frost across the whole country.
On Friday, new rain will spread and the wind will strengthen.
